cause: a corruption trace contained an atom_insert with TWO existing neighbours -- the inverse of deleting a BRIDGING (degree-2) atom. The factorized model routes AtomInsert to grow_root (0 neighbours) or grow_connected (exactly 1); there is no head for 2+.
error: ValueError: factorized grow supports one existing neighbor
fix: production_edit_corpus.trace_is_representable drops any trace with an atom_insert of >1 neighbour at packed load, counted and logged as unrepresentable_traces_dropped - the same policy build_corrupted_prior_records already applies to ring/graft steps

incidence.mmp_layer: 0 of 50,000 sampled records - MMP is NOT a source

not_done: the model was NOT changed to score multi-neighbour inserts (that would be an architecture change)
observed_payload: neighbors [[5,1],[16,1]] in packed corruption shard c_0016
why_not_caught_earlier: the in-memory corruption used 200 sources - 375x too small to contain one
the 200-step A100 benchmark returns before the first evaluation at step 250, so it never ran far enough
